queue.detail: Console (level 13, cam 3760/192, mario 3759/212, Right held): arm f28 (Mario frozen at world 3779, sPipeTravelDirection=$30), sSceneId=$10 at f52, scene ops f67-f70, Mario placed f75, fade set f68, fade 0 f420, parts act f421. Port: arm f29 at the same 3779 (the $188B walk-in arm is right), but sSceneId=$10 at f52, ops f53-f57, placed f92, fade f54 -> 0 at f444, parts f444. So the port's arm-to-placement is 63 frames vs the console's 47: 23 frames of pipe_dir = 3 slide plus a 40-frame camera transition. The console's ops run *inside* the travel (sPipeTravelDirection still $30 at f67-f70, 8 frames before the placement), so the VM is not gated on 'is Mario travelling': that was tried and reverted (it runs the $2x arm after the placement and lands Mario at 1308 instead of 1561). The ROM's travelling sub-phase ends before sPipeTravelDirection clears, and that is the thing to model. Also still true: PlayerSim::step's sFadeTimer decrement is skipped on travel frames, which is only correct while no scene has armed a fade before a travel.
